meaning.zh-TW: 車輛與路面電車必須在無號誌交叉口前停車。
meaning.en: Vehicles and streetcars must stop immediately before an intersection without traffic control.

action.zh-TW: 在停止線前完全停止，左右確認後再前進。
action.en: Come to a complete stop before the stop line, check both sides, then proceed only when safe.

meaning.zh-TW: 車輛與路面電車必須慢行。
meaning.en: Vehicles and streetcars must slow down.

action.zh-TW: 把速度降到能立即停車的程度；不要只稍微鬆開油門。
action.en: Reduce to a speed from which you can stop immediately; easing off slightly is not enough.

meaning.zh-TW: 這是一方通行道路的出口；不得從反方向駛入。
meaning.en: This marks the exit of a one-way street; vehicles must not enter from the opposite direction.

action.zh-TW: 不要依導航轉入；繼續走合法路線重新導航。
action.en: Do not follow navigation into it; continue on a legal route and let navigation recalculate.

meaning.zh-TW: 車輛不得逆著標誌箭頭方向行駛。
meaning.en: Vehicles must not proceed opposite to the arrow shown on the sign.

action.zh-TW: 只沿箭頭方向進入與行駛；轉彎前再次確認方向。
action.en: Enter and travel only in the arrow direction; recheck it before turning.

assetLabels.en: Red X: no stopping or parking

title.zh-TW: 紅色 X／一條斜線：差一條線，差很多
title.en: Red X / one slash: a major difference

meaning.zh-TW: 紅色 X 原則上連短暫停靠都禁止；一條斜線禁止駐車，但上下客或短時間貨物裝卸等不屬於駐車的情況仍可能適用。附牌會再限定時間、路段或車種。
meaning.en: The red X generally prohibits even brief stopping. One slash prohibits parking, while passenger pickup/drop-off or brief goods loading may fall outside parking. Auxiliary plates may further limit time, section or vehicle class.

action.zh-TW: 看到 X 就不要停；一條斜線也不能等人、買東西或下車拍照。主標誌和下方附牌要一起看。
action.en: Do not stop at the X. At one slash, do not wait, shop or leave for photos. Read the main sign and its auxiliary plate together.

meaning.zh-TW: 數字指定車輛與路面電車的最高速度，單位為 km/h。圖示的 50 只是官方範例。
meaning.en: The number sets the maximum speed for motor vehicles and streetcars in km/h. The shown 50 is an official example.

action.zh-TW: 依現場數字，不要把範例的 50 當成所有道路的固定速限。
action.en: Follow the posted number; do not treat the example 50 as a universal limit.

meaning.en: Vehicles must not make a U-turn.

action.zh-TW: 錯過入口時繼續前進，找合法地點重新規劃。
action.en: If you miss an entrance, continue and reroute at a legal location.

action.zh-TW: 提早減速並掃視兩側；有人正在或準備通過時停車讓行。
action.en: Slow early and scan both sides; stop for people crossing or about to cross.

meaning.zh-TW: 警告前方有平交道，需要減速並提高注意。
meaning.en: Warns that a railway crossing is ahead and closer attention is required.

action.zh-TW: 提早減速；到達平交道時依現場號誌、遮斷機與停止規則處理。
action.en: Slow early; at the crossing, obey its signals, barriers, and stopping requirements.

meaning.zh-TW: 只供已裝 ETC 車載器且 ETC 卡可用的車輛通行。
meaning.en: Only vehicles with a working ETC onboard unit and ETC card may use this lane.

action.zh-TW: 租車未確認 ETC 可用時，走一般車道；不要在收費站前突然切換車道。
action.en: If your rental's ETC status is not confirmed, use an ordinary lane; do not make a sudden lane change at the gate.

rightsNote.zh-TW: NEXCO 圖片條款不允許轉載至其他網站，因此僅連結官方圖例，不在本站複製或仿畫。
rightsNote.en: NEXCO's image terms prohibit reposting on another website, so this guide links to the official example and does not copy or redraw it.
